notes: DiscoFlate v3.39.0 (consolidation, part 5) — Timed Events gain an 'actions' action type: a full action block run each round (message/embed/fire/award/competition/command_gate/…), with loop placeholders ([current_loop]/[event]/[next_round]) — just like a command's actions. The simple single-action types stay for the common case + clean-previous loops. Also: Competitions and Bonus Rounds are now clearly separated collapsible sections.
